messages:
olivia: FYI escalation from LumenPay — after their IdP cert rotation some users are getting 403 on our /saml/acs endpoint. Customer says it started ~09:00 UTC. They can reproduce with 2 of 5 test accounts.
samir: Can you drop the tenant id and a snippet of the SP logs? also whether they're using Azure AD or a custom IdP.
olivia: Tenant: lumenpay-prod. IdP: Azure AD (dialog indicated dual-key rollover). SP logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z ERROR saml: Assertion recipient mismatch. expected=https://lumenpay.app/sso/acs/ got=https://lumenpay.app/sso/acs
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z WARN saml: SignatureValidationError: no matching cert in metadata keyset
2026-03-17T09:12:04Z INFO auth: login failed - status=403 user=test-user-2
```
olivia: Repro steps provided by customer: 1) Click SSO sign-in on app, 2) redirected to IdP, 3) complete auth, 4) redirected back and see 403. They say older mobile clients unaffected.
jen (eng-sre): Two quick suspects: trailing-slash normalization + stale metadata (watcher cache). Azure dual-key rotation can sign some assertions with the old key while metadata updates; if our metadata watcher still has only the new cert order or an old cache, verification can fail. Can you paste their IdP metadata URL?
olivia: Metadata URL: https://login.microsoftonline.com/lumenpay/federationmetadata/2007-06/federationmetadata.xml. We attempted a manual metadata refresh via console and saw 200. Customer still sees failures.
samir: Post the raw SAMLResponse (redact PII) or at least the Recipient/Audience fields. If recipient in the Assertion doesn't exactly match the ACS we expect (trailing slash) we reject. We usually normalize but host/proxy rewrites sometimes drop trailing slash.
olivia: Snippet from Assertion (redacted):
```
<Assertion>
  <SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://lumenpay.app/sso/acs" NotOnOrAfter="2026-03-17T09:13:00Z"/>
</Assertion>
```
jen (eng-sre): That Recipient vs expected https://lumenpay.app/sso/acs/ is the smoking gun for some logins. Two parallel tracks: 1) metadata cache / cert rotation causing signature errors, 2) normalization mismatch. For (1) we need a forced re-poll and to verify the metadata contains both signing keys. For (2) we can enable a lenient recipient check for the tenant temporarily. I can create a safe short-lived config toggle.
olivia: Customer already rotated to keep old cert for 48h but says some assertions are still signed with old key. Their note: "Azure shows both keys present; some downstream vendors see intermittent failures."
triage-bot: Created internal ticket INF-8792: "lumenpay metadata re-poll + tenant-level lenient-acs toggle" assigned to tyler. Priority: P1 (customer-impacting).
tyler: I cleared the CDN/edge cache for federation metadata endpoints and forced the metadata watcher to re-poll for tenant lumenpay-prod just now. Commands run: `metadata-watcher refresh --tenant lumenpay-prod --force` -> exit 0.
jen (eng-sre): Tyler — can you also check the metadata key ordering and that both <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> entries are present? If both there, we should be able to verify both signatures. If not, relay the exact metadata XML we pulled.
tyler: Confirmed two signing keys present in the pulled metadata and both certs in the KeyDescriptor blocks. Also verified cache TTL was lowered to 30s for the forced recheck.
samir: I've pushed tenant flag `saml.accept_alternate_recipient=true` for lumenpay-prod for 2 hours to accept recipient with/without trailing slash during the window. Also added a short log hook to count how many matches rely on alternate recipient.
olivia: Just heard back from LumenPay: after your refresh + toggle ~90% of their users can sign in. The remaining failures are older Android versions that strip trailing slash from redirect URIs in the SAML client. Customer will update their mobile client but asked if we can run fallback for those sessions.
jen (eng-sre): For the remaining clients we can keep the lenient flag a little longer but we should coordinate removal once their client updates. Also leaving a note to check replay/audit for any anomalies.
olivia: Customer confirmed a gradual recovery and will notify once all clients updated. I'll keep INF-8792 open and schedule a follow-up call tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
